summary: Transform minimal dark login page into professional occupational health medical report provider landing page with light blue & white theme. Includes 6 phases: Foundation setup, Layout components, Landing sections, Auth refactor, Integration, and E2E testing.

phases.name: Foundation & Theme Setup
phases.description: Establish medical light blue & white color scheme and add required shadcn/ui components

subtasks.description: Add medical blue CSS variables to src/index.css - Add to :root section (--medical-blue, --medical-blue-foreground, --medical-blue-light, --medical-blue-dark, --trust-green) and @theme inline section. Include dark mode variants in .dark selector.
acceptanceCriteria: Medical blue colors visible in CSS variables
@theme inline mappings for all medical colors

subtasks.description: Install shadcn/ui components: input, label, dialog, navigation-menu, sheet, avatar, badge, separator. Run npx shadcn@latest add for each component.
Add medical button variant to src/components/ui/button.tsx - Add 'medical' and 'medical-outline' variants to buttonVariants cva config.
Create directory structure: src/components/layout/, src/components/landing/, src/components/auth/

phases.gateCondition: npm run typecheck passes with no errors

phases.name: Layout Components
phases.description: Create reusable layout components: Container, NavigationBar, and Footer

subtasks.description: Create Container component at src/components/layout/Container.tsx - Wrapper with container mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-7xl classes, accepts children and className props.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses cn() utility for className merging

subtasks.description: Create NavigationBar component at src/components/layout/NavigationBar.tsx - Sticky header with Stethoscope logo, nav links (Features, Testimonials, Pricing, About), Login/Request Demo buttons, mobile Sheet menu.
acceptanceCriteria: Has responsive mobile menu using Sheet

subtasks.description: Create Footer component at src/components/layout/Footer.tsx - 4-column grid with brand, services, company, compliance sections. Shield and Lock icons for HIPAA/SSL badges.
acceptanceCriteria: HIPAA Compliant badge with Shield icon
256-bit SSL Encryption badge with Lock icon

subtasks.description: Create barrel export at src/components/layout/index.ts - Export Container, NavigationBar, Footer

phases.gateCondition: npm run typecheck passes with no errors

phases.name: Landing Page Sections
phases.description: Create main landing page content sections: Hero, Features, Testimonials, CTA

subtasks.description: Create HeroSection component at src/components/landing/HeroSection.tsx - Gradient background (medical-blue-light to background), HIPAA badge, headline 'Occupational Health Reports Simplified', stats (24h, 99.9%, 500+), Request Demo and Watch Video buttons, mock report card illustration.
acceptanceCriteria: Two CTAs: Request Demo, Watch Video

subtasks.description: Create FeaturesSection component at src/components/landing/FeaturesSection.tsx - 6 feature cards with icons: Pre-Employment Assessments (Building2), Health Surveillance (Activity), 24-Hour Turnaround (Clock), HIPAA Compliant (Shield), Multi-Provider Network (Users), Digital Reports (FileText).
acceptanceCriteria: Each card has icon in medical-blue/10 background
Section has id='features' for nav scroll

subtasks.description: Create TestimonialsSection component at src/components/landing/TestimonialsSection.tsx - 3 testimonial cards with Quote icon, author info, company. Authors: Dr. Sarah Chen (TechCorp), James Mitchell (BuildRight), Dr. Emily Rodriguez (SafeWork).
acceptanceCriteria: Section has id='testimonials' for nav scroll

subtasks.description: Create CTASection component at src/components/landing/CTASection.tsx - Full-width medical blue background, headline about transformation, two buttons: Get Started Today and Schedule a Call.
Create barrel export at src/components/landing/index.ts - Export HeroSection, FeaturesSection, TestimonialsSection, CTASection

phases.gateCondition: npm run typecheck passes with no errors

phases.name: Auth Component Refactor
phases.description: Extract and improve authentication components from App.tsx

subtasks.description: Create SignInForm component at src/components/auth/SignInForm.tsx - Form with email/password inputs, loading spinner (Loader2), user-friendly error mapping, flow toggle (signIn/signUp), medical-blue focus rings. Uses @convex-dev/auth/react signIn.
Create SignOutButton component at src/components/auth/SignOutButton.tsx - Button that only renders when authenticated, uses signOut from @convex-dev/auth/react, LogOut icon option.
Create AuthModal component at src/components/auth/AuthModal.tsx - Dialog wrapper around SignInForm with Stethoscope icon header, controlled open state, closes on successful auth.
acceptanceCriteria: Closes modal on successful sign in

subtasks.description: Create barrel export at src/components/auth/index.ts - Export SignInForm, SignOutButton, AuthModal

phases.gateCondition: npm run typecheck passes with no errors

phases.name: Integration & Polish
phases.description: Integrate all components into App.tsx and finalize the complete landing page

subtasks.description: Update NavigationBar to use AuthModal - Replace Login button with AuthModal trigger, Request Demo button with AuthModal trigger (initialFlow='signUp'). Update both desktop and mobile menu sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop Login button wrapped in AuthModal
Desktop Request Demo button wrapped in AuthModal with initialFlow='signUp'
Mobile menu buttons wrapped in AuthModal

subtasks.description: Replace App.tsx with modular version - Import layout (NavigationBar, Footer), landing (HeroSection, FeaturesSection, TestimonialsSection, CTASection), and auth (AuthModal, SignOutButton) components. Create LandingPage, AuthenticatedNav, and Dashboard internal components.
acceptanceCriteria: Floating Provider Login button in fixed position
Dashboard shows welcome message and demo stats

phases.gateCondition: npm run typecheck passes AND npm run dev serves landing page at localhost:5173

phases.name: E2E Testing
phases.description: Comprehensive Browser-CLI tests for the hero landing page on port 5175

subtasks.description: Start dev server on port 5175 and verify Browser-CLI connection - Run VITE_PORT=5175 npm run dev:frontend, navigate to localhost:5175, take initial snapshot and screenshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Initial snapshot shows landing page structure

subtasks.description: Test landing page sections - Verify Hero section elements (headline, HIPAA badge, stats, CTAs), Features section (6 cards), Testimonials section (3 cards), CTA section, Footer (compliance badges). Take screenshots for evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section: headline, HIPAA badge, stats visible
Footer: HIPAA Compliant and SSL badges visible

subtasks.description: Test auth modal flow - Click Login button, verify modal opens with form fields, test form validation, enter test credentials from .env.local, submit and verify dashboard appears, test sign out returns to landing.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth modal opens on Login click
Form has Email and Password fields
Sign out returns to landing page

subtasks.description: Test responsive design - Resize to mobile (375x812), verify hamburger menu appears and works. Resize to tablet (768x1024), verify layout adapts. Reset to desktop.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile: hamburger menu appears, Sheet opens

subtasks.description: Save visual baselines - Save screenshot baselines for landing-hero, landing-features, landing-testimonials. Save snapshot baseline for landing-structure.
Run accessibility audit - Execute auditAccessibility command, get results in summary format, verify no critical violations.
Capture performance metrics - Run capturePerformanceMetrics, get metrics, verify LCP < 2500ms, TTFB < 800ms.

phases.gateCondition: All E2E tests pass, visual baselines saved, accessibility audit shows no critical violations

risks.description: shadcn component installation may fail or have version conflicts
risks.mitigation: Run components one at a time, check package.json for conflicts after each install

risks.description: CSS variables may not apply correctly in dark mode
risks.mitigation: Test dark mode toggle during phase 1, verify oklch color values render correctly

risks.description: Convex auth flow may have changed since original implementation
risks.mitigation: Verify @convex-dev/auth API by reading existing App.tsx before refactoring

risks.description: Port 5175 may conflict with existing processes
risks.mitigation: Check with lsof -ti:5175 before starting, kill existing process if needed

risks.description: Browser-CLI may timeout on slow page loads
risks.mitigation: Increase wait durations, use waitForSelector with explicit timeouts
